test_cases.title: Scheme search with an unknown name shows no results
acs: DERIVED: Scheme search by name shows "There are no Results to Display" when nothing matches - /Scheme Admin/Search.aspx (probe 2026-11-02)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Scheme Admin/Search.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The page loads, the h1 reads Search and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the text above the search box.
steps.expected: The text reads: This page can be used to search for Schemes.

steps.action: Type ZZ-NO-SUCH-SCHEME in the Scheme Name box.
steps.expected: The box shows ZZ-NO-SUCH-SCHEME.

steps.action: Click the Search button.
steps.expected: The page reloads with the h1 Search and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the Search Results area.
steps.expected: The message reads: There are no Results to Display.

test_cases.title: Scheme search with a known name lists results
acs: DERIVED: Scheme search by name lists matching schemes - /Scheme Admin/Search.aspx (seeded PT0001 African Horse Sickness (AHS))
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin.
The seeded scheme African Horse Sickness (AHS) exists.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Scheme Admin/Search.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The page loads, the h1 reads Search and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Type African Horse Sickness in the Scheme Name box.
steps.expected: The box shows African Horse Sickness.

steps.action: Click the Search button.
steps.expected: The page reloads with the h1 Search and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the Search Results area.
steps.expected: The message There are no Results to Display is not shown.

steps.action: Look for the scheme name in the results.
steps.expected: A result containing African Horse Sickness is listed.

test_cases.title: Create User search with an unknown id keeps the page and creates no user
acs: DERIVED: Create User offers a search box and a Search button and creates nothing on search - /Admin/UserCreate.aspx (probe 2026-11-02)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin.
zz999999 matches no user. No user is created.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Admin/UserCreate.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The page loads, the h1 reads Create User and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the instruction text.
steps.expected: The text reads: Type in the Id number (eg m123456), forename or surname of the user to be created.

steps.action: Type zz999999 in the search box.
steps.expected: The box shows zz999999.

steps.action: Click the Search button.
steps.expected: The page reloads with the h1 Create User.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown and the h1 is still Create User.
